hmong: Kuv cog noob zaub rau hauv av ntub.
english: I plant vegetable seeds in moist soil.

hmong: Cov av hauv lub vaj no zoo rau cog zaub.
english: The soil in this garden is good for growing vegetables.

hmong: Tsob ntoo ntawd muab duab ntxoov ntxoo rau peb.
english: That tree gives us shade.

hmong: Kuv rho cov nroj tawm hauv lub vaj zaub.
english: I pull the weeds out of the vegetable garden.

hmong: Cov hmab taub nce raws lub laj kab.
english: The squash vines climb along the fence.

hmong: Cov pejxeem tawm tsam txoj cai tshiab ntawd.
english: The people oppose that new law.

hmong: Ob pab tub rog sib tawm tsam ze ntawm lub nroog.
english: The two armies battle each other near the city.

hmong: Cov neeg khiav mus nkaum thaum lawv hnov npoos tawg.
english: People ran for shelter when they heard a bomb explode.

hmong: Tub ceev xwm nqa phom raws li txoj cai thiab kev cob qhia.
english: Police carry firearms according to law and training.

hmong: Tus caij maus taus hnav kaus mom kom nyab xeeb.
english: The motorcycle rider wears a helmet for safety.

hmong: Cov pejxeem ntshai tsam muaj kev tseb tua nrog los ntawm lwm lub teb chaws.
english: The people fear an invasion from another country.

hmong: Thaj chaw ntawd muaj caws foob pob, ces tsis txhob taug kev mus ntawd.
english: That area has land mines, so do not walk there.

hmong: Txhua tus xav kom muaj kev thaj yeeb hauv lawv lub zej zog.
english: Everyone wants peace in their community.

hmong: Cov neeg nyob hauv zos tau tawm khiav thaum muaj kev sib ntaus.
english: The villagers fled when fighting began.

hmong: Tsov rog ua rau ntau tsev neeg tau khiav tawm lawv lub zos.
english: War caused many families to flee their villages.

hmong: Tus neeg tua hneev tua ib rab xib xub rau ntawm lub hom phiaj.
english: The archer shot an arrow at the target.

hmong: Kuv nyiam cov caij nyoog hauv Xeev Minnesota.
english: I like the seasons in Minnesota.
note: the model's sentence used `lub caij nyoog`, not the headword `cov caij nyoog`; and states take `Xeev`

hmong: Lub caij ntuj tshiab, cov paj pib tawg thiab huab cua sov zuj zus.
english: In spring, flowers begin to bloom and the weather gradually gets warmer.

hmong: Lub caij ntuj sov peb nyiam mus ua si tom pas dej.
english: In summer, we like to go to the lake.

hmong: Lub caij ntuj tsaug, cov nplooj hloov xim thiab poob los.
english: In autumn, the leaves change color and fall.

hmong: Lub caij ntuj no hauv Xeev Minnesota muaj daus ntau.
english: Winter in Minnesota has a lot of snow.

hmong: Nws tau qhov chaw thib ib hauv kev sib tw.
english: They got first place in the competition.

hmong: Koj xav tias zaj yeeb yaj duab ntawd zoo li cas?
english: What do you think the movie is like?

hmong: Kuv xum nyob tsev dua li tawm mus thaum nag los.
english: I would rather stay home than go out when it is raining.

hmong: Koj yuav tsum kawm kom tiav ua ntej koj mus ua si.
english: You must finish studying before you go play.

hmong: Nws ua pa tob tob kom nws tus kheej nqig.
english: They breathe deeply to calm themselves.

hmong: Nws hnoos ntau heev vim nws mob khaub thuas.
english: He is coughing a lot because he has a cold.
